organization.disambiguatingDescription: Lamprozo is a hardcore Pokémon Nuzlocker, herper, and disc golfer creating long-form Nuzlocke and ROM hack runs on Twitch and YouTube. The channel name is derived from Lampropeltis zonata — the California Mountain Kingsnake. Since starting Nuzlockes in November 2024, Lamprozo has accumulated over 1000 hours of Nuzlocke experience and focuses on the most punishing ROM hacks in the genre, including Sterling Silver, Renegade Platinum, and Platinum Kaizo. Not affiliated with any other content creators or projects using similar names.
organization.contactDescription: Get in touch with Lamprozo for collaborations and business inquiries.

founders.name: Lamprozo
founders.description: Hardcore Pokémon Nuzlocker with 1000+ hours of experience since November 2024. Creates long-form challenge runs on Twitch and YouTube. Beyond gaming, Lamprozo is an avid herper (searching for reptiles and amphibians in the wild) and disc golfer. Other favorite games include Undertale and Xenoblade Chronicles.
